label: Some / any
outcome: Lo studente sceglie some o any in base a polarità e funzione comunicativa, usando some nelle affermative e nelle offerte/richieste essenziali e any nelle negative e nelle domande informative aperte, con nomi countable e uncountable appropriati.
must_master: some in common offers and concrete requests when required
some/any with plural countables and uncountables
meaning/function over a simplistic question-mark rule

scope_boundary.compound_pronouns: Do not teach someone/anything/etc.; indefinite pronouns belong to a later topic.
scope_boundary.advanced_some_any: Do not teach nuanced stressed any, any meaning 'whichever', or formal/idiomatic exceptions.
scope_boundary.countability: Countability is a prerequisite and may be checked, but do not reteach the entire countable/uncountable lesson.

italian_learner_risks.risk: using any in every question including offers

quality_rejections: teaching the false rule 'all questions use any'
ten sentence-polarity drills with no communicative function
rare exceptions before offers/requests are secure
compound indefinite pronouns as target content
ambiguous questions where both some and any are defensible because speaker expectation is unspecified
